name: Habits
description: A private habit, training & reflection tracker for Standard Notes: check-off / count / workout-session habits, Today / Calendar / Training / Stats / Insights / Journal views. Includes a daily progress ring, 7-day momentum strips, streaks, a training log (duration, distance, RPE with weekly volume + trends), a reflective journal (prompts, mood, search, on-this-day), gamification (XP, levels, achievement badges), a local Insights dashboard, and a note-size health guardrail. All data is stored inside the note and protected by Standard Notes' end-to-end encryption.
